$comment: STEP 40 skill-discovery probes for the two editorial skills, in the tests/evaluation/provider-probes.json schema so tests/evaluation/run-provider-probes.mjs can run them with --spec tests/evaluation/step40/discovery-probes.json (billed; explicit authorization and --allow-provider-calls required). Run each probe at least 3 times (--runs 3) per provider and record denominators. expect.any_of = at least one listed chayen skill loads and no unlisted chayen skill loads (so any extra or different chayen skill is a wrong selection); expect.none = no chayen skill loads; expect.none_or = only the listed skills may load. Explicit probes use the provider's own invocation syntax, added by the runner; they count only when the named skill is observed (Skill tool event, a read of one of its references, or the marker). `group` feeds the Step 40 metrics in tools/evals/score-step40.mjs: explicit-th, explicit-en, implicit-th, implicit-en, overlap-doc, engineering, no-match. Prompts never name the plugin or the skills except through explicit invocation.
